test_interrupted_turn_does_not_sync: test that AIAgent skips memory sync when a conversation turn is interrupted
test_completed_turn_syncs_and_queues_pre: test that AIAgent syncs memory and queues prefetch for completed turns
test_sync_external_memory_for_turn_matri: test the parametrized matrix of interrupted, response, and user message combinations for memory sync
test_sync_exception_is_swallowed: test that AIAgent swallows exceptions from the external memory backend without crashing
test_no_memory_manager_is_a_no_op: test that AIAgent handles a None memory manager gracefully without raising errors
